name: io.github.david00769/banktivity-swift-mcp
title: Banktivity
description: Banktivity MCP server for .bank8 vaults; writes go through Core Data so CloudKit sync sees them.

environmentVariables.name: BANKTIVITY_FILE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to your .bank8 vault; if unset, the single Banktivity 10 vault is used

environmentVariables.name: BANKTIVITY_STORE_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to open the vault read-only
